headline: Ali Shirvani jumps from 385th to 60th on ARC-2

sections.text: Ali Shirvani gained 5.41 points to reach 36.94, moving from 385th to 60th on the ARC-AGI-2 public board.
The climb carries Shirvani into the top 100; the board’s 15th-place gold cutoff stands at 58.06.
